>Open source for the future of finance\.<

>A portfolio of Python, Rust and JavaScript libraries I created and Meintain\. Open source, free to use, and applied to wholesale payments, cross-border settlement, financial data and quantum-resistant cryptography\.<

>Portofolio pustaka Python, Rust, dan JavaScript yang saya tulis dan pelihara. Sumber terbuka, bebas digunakan, diterapkan pada pembayaran grosir, penyelesaian lintas batas, data keuangan, dan kriptografi tahan-kuantum.<

A Python library that automates ISO 20022 pain\.001 payment file creation from CSV or SQLite\.\s*Built for the global migration from MT/MX to structured messages across SWIFT, SEPA and major schemes\.
Pustaka Python yang mengotomatiskan pembuatan berkas pembayaran ISO 20022 pain.001 dari CSV atau SQLite. Dibangun untuk migrasi global MT/MX ke pesan terstruktur di SWIFT, SEPA, dan skema utama.
Generate, validate and deliver ISO 20022 pacs\.008 FI-to-FI customer credit transfer messages\.\s*JSON Schema, XSD validation, IBAN across 75 countries, GDPR/PCI-DSS-compliant PII masking\.
Menghasilkan, memvalidasi, dan mengirim pesan ISO 20022 pacs.008 untuk transfer kredit pelanggan FI-ke-FI. JSON Schema, validasi XSD, IBAN di 75 negara, penyamaran PII yang sesuai GDPR/PCI-DSS.

A finance-grade Python toolkit that turns multi-format bank statements into structured data\.\s*Designed for the realities of real-world statement files and the audit demands of regulated environments\.
Toolkit Python berkualitas keuangan yang mengubah laporan rekening multi-format menjadi data terstruktur. Dirancang untuk realitas berkas laporan dunia nyata dan tuntutan audit lingkungan teregulasi.
A Rust library implementing secure hash and digest algorithms for password encryption and verification\.\s*Designed with a quantum-resistant posture for the post-PQC era of authentication\.
Pustaka Rust yang mengimplementasikan algoritma hash dan digest yang aman untuk enkripsi dan verifikasi kata sandi. Dirancang dengan postur tahan-kuantum untuk era pasca-PQC otentikasi.
A robust Rust implementation of CRYSTALS-Kyber, the NIST FIPS 203 standard for general-purpose post-quantum encryption\.\s*The foundation for quantum-resistant payment authentication\.
Implementasi Rust yang andal dari CRYSTALS-Kyber, standar NIST FIPS 203 untuk enkripsi pasca-kuantum umum. Fondasi otentikasi pembayaran tahan-kuantum.

A pure-Rust YAML 1\.2 ecosystem\. Zero unsafe, 100% spec compliance \(406 / 406 official suite\), streaming-first serde, lossless CST and JSON-Schema validation\.\s*Library \+ CLI \(noyafmt, noyavalidate\) \+ LSP \+ MCP \+ WASM bindings\.

Ekosistem YAML 1.2 100% Rust. Tanpa unsafe, kepatuhan 100% (406/406 suite resmi), serde streaming-first, CST lossless, dan validasi JSON-Schema. Pustaka + CLI (noyafmt, noyavalidate) + LSP + MCP + binding WASM.

Quantum computing threatens the cryptographic foundations of financial services\.\s*Payments, from real-time to cross-border settlement, rely on protections that quantum computing will eventually render obsolete\.

Komputasi kuantum mengancam fondasi kriptografi layanan keuangan. Pembayaran — dari real-time hingga penyelesaian lintas batas — bergantung pada perlindungan yang pada akhirnya akan dibuat usang oleh komputasi kuantum.
>Quantum-Safe Payments white paper · September 2025 · Read the paper<
>Industry white paper for the Emerging Payments Association Asia\.\s*The structural threat quantum computing poses to payment infrastructure, and the case for coordinated action now\.<
>Whitepaper industri untuk Emerging Payments Association Asia. Ancaman struktural komputasi kuantum pada infrastruktur pembayaran, dan perlunya tindakan terkoordinasi sekarang juga.<
>Why the payments industry must act now\.<
>Regulators are treating harvest-now-decrypt-later as a credible present risk\. This paper outlines the structural threat and the urgent case for coordinated action across wholesale payment rails\.

>Regulator kini memperlakukan «harvest now, decrypt later» sebagai risiko nyata yang kredibel. Whitepaper ini menjabarkan ancaman struktural dan perlunya tindakan terkoordinasi di rel pembayaran grosir.
>Recent research and writing on quantum-safe cryptography, ISO 20022 migration and the future of wholesale payments\.<
>Riset dan tulisan terbaru tentang kriptografi tahan-kuantum, migrasi ISO 20022, dan masa depan pembayaran grosir.<

Stablecoins cannot pay yield under the GENIUS Act\. BlackRock's BRSRV and BSTBL filings show the workaround — a tokenised money-market fund running alongside a regulated stablecoin to deliver yield through an adjacent, compliant rail\.

Les stablecoins ne peuvent pas verser de rendement sous le GENIUS Act. Les dépôts BRSRV et BSTBL de BlackRock dévoilent le contournement : un fonds monétaire tokenisé qui roule en parallèle d'un stablecoin régulé pour livrer du rendement via un rail conforme adjacent.

Quantum risk has moved from research curiosity to active regulatory mandate\. With the G7 roadmap published in January 2026 and BIS Project Leap proving feasibility in live payment systems, the board-level question is no longer whether to migrate\.

Le risque quantique est passé de curiosité de recherche à mandat réglementaire actif. Avec la roadmap G7 publiée en Januari 2026 et BIS Project Leap démontrant la faisabilité sur des systèmes de paiement en production, la question au niveau du conseil n'est plus de savoir s'il faut migrer.

From November 2026, SWIFT CBPR\+ rejects unstructured postal addresses in cross-border payment messages\. Six months out, 65% of pacs\.008 messages still ship non-compliant addresses and 44% of banks reMein behind on the remediation programme\.

À partir de November 2026, SWIFT CBPR+ rejette les adresses postales non structurées dans les messages de paiement transfrontaliers. À six mois, 65 % des messages pacs.008 livrent encore des adresses non conformes et 44 % des banques sont en retard sur le programme de remédiation.

Problem
Hand-authoring ISO 20022 pain\.001 is fragile under SEPA and SWIFT cutovers\.
Approach
Schema-driven Python that maps CSV or SQLite into validated payment XML\.
Outcome
Ops ship pain\.001 in minutes; the audit trail survives the migration\.

Impact ISO 20022 · SEPA \+ SWIFT

Masalah
Pembuatan manual ISO 20022 pain.001 rentan saat peralihan SEPA dan SWIFT.
Pendekatan
Python berbasis skema yang memetakan CSV atau SQLite ke XML pembayaran tervalidasi.
Hasil
Tim operasional menerbitkan pain.001 dalam hitungan menit; jejak audit bertahan melewati migrasi.

Dampak ISO 20022 · SEPA + SWIFT

Problem
FI-to-FI credit transfers fail audit when XSD, IBAN and PII rules diverge\.
Approach
One library: JSON Schema, XSD, IBAN across 75 countries, GDPR-grade masking\.
Outcome
Cross-border credit transfers that pass first-time at the regulator\.

Impact 75 countries · IBAN

Masalah
Transfer kredit FI-to-FI gagal audit ketika aturan XSD, IBAN, dan PII berbeda.
Pendekatan
Satu pustaka: JSON Schema, XSD, IBAN untuk 75 negara, penyamaran berstandar GDPR.
Hasil
Transfer kredit lintas batas yang lolos audit regulator pada percobaan pertama.

Dampak 75 negara · IBAN

Problem
Statement formats trap reconciliation teams in manual rekeying\.
Approach
One Python toolkit that normalises multi-format statements with audit-grade lineage\.
Outcome
Reconciliation runs without bespoke per-bank glue code\.

Impact Multi-format · Audit-grade

Masalah
Format laporan membelenggu tim rekonsiliasi dalam entri ulang manual.
Pendekatan
Satu toolkit Python yang menormalisasi laporan multi-format dengan jejak audit berstandar tinggi.
Hasil
Rekonsiliasi berjalan tanpa kode perekat khusus per bank.

Dampak Multi-format · Berstandar Audit

Problem
Pre-PQC hashing libraries leave credential stores quantum-exposed\.
Approach
Memory-safe Rust hash and digest library with a post-quantum posture\.
Outcome
Drop-in secure hashing for services planning PQC migration\.

Impact Memory-safe · Rust

Masalah
Pustaka hashing pra-PQC membiarkan penyimpanan kredensial terekspos terhadap komputasi kuantum.
Pendekatan
Pustaka hash dan digest Rust aman-memori dengan postur post-quantum.
Hasil
Hashing aman siap pakai untuk layanan yang merencanakan migrasi PQC.

Dampak Aman-Memori · Rust

Problem
Tier-1 banks carry harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure on every TLS session\.
Approach
Pure-Rust CRYSTALS-Kyber \(NIST FIPS 203\) that plugs into existing auth flows\.
Outcome
Post-quantum key exchange in production-grade Rust, independently validated\.

Impact NIST FIPS 203

Masalah
Bank-bank Tier-1 menanggung eksposur harvest-now-decrypt-later pada setiap sesi TLS.
Pendekatan
CRYSTALS-Kyber pure-Rust (NIST FIPS 203) yang terhubung langsung ke alur autentikasi yang ada.
Hasil
Pertukaran kunci post-quantum dalam Rust berstandar produksi, tervalidasi secara independen.

Dampak NIST FIPS 203

Problem
AI, MCP and config pipelines run on YAML parsers with C-backed UB and silent spec drift\.
Approach
Pure-Rust YAML 1\.2 across library, CLI, LSP, MCP and WASM — zero unsafe, full spec\.
Outcome
YAML pipelines that stop being the supply-chain weak link\.

Impact 406 \/ 406 spec · 0 unsafe

Masalah
Pipeline AI, MCP, dan konfigurasi berjalan pada parser YAML berbasis C dengan UB dan penyimpangan spesifikasi yang tidak terdeteksi.
Pendekatan
YAML 1.2 pure-Rust mencakup pustaka, CLI, LSP, MCP, dan WASM — nol unsafe, spesifikasi penuh.
Hasil
Pipeline YAML yang tidak lagi menjadi titik lemah rantai pasokan perangkat lunak.

Dampak 406 / 406 spesifikasi · 0 unsafe
